name: agent-hub
description: Optional. Picks an Orca workspace by its exact id, host and real folder, then opens the existing agent-hub console, dashboard or family console for it. It approves, assigns and stops nothing.

settings.title: Other host ids that mean this Mac
settings.description: Comma separated. Orca's own id for this machine, local, always counts. A workspace on any other host id not listed here is treated as remote and nothing is run for it on this Mac.

settings.title: Treat a missing host id as this Mac
settings.description: Orca leaves a workspace's host id empty for some workspaces. Turn this on only if all of yours are on this Mac.

settings.title: ahub executable
settings.description: Absolute path to the installed ahub command. Empty uses `ahub` from PATH.
